criteria.claim: Historical experience improves quality and/or cost over Knowledge-only retrieval on sealed holdout variants, proven only by the frozen paired ablation evaluator.
Only the planted stable pattern candidate is identified; frequency-only, narrow-context, and correlation traps are denied with INVALID_DIVERSITY_PROOF.
Similar-looking but inapplicable tasks and version-drift cases deny pattern reuse; similarity cannot override applicability, version, context, or evidence gates.
Ablation and replay remain simulation/shadow-only and evidence-bound: no live state change, no model or service call, no procedure content, and every fail-closed boundary is exercised.
Pattern candidates preserve dependencies, known failures, counterexamples, and provenance with complete counterevidence coverage.

nonClaims: This is an admitted synthetic shadow replay only.
It is not a production quality, cost, efficiency, or generalization claim.
It grants no execution authority and contains no procedure content.
It calls no model, provider, service, tool, storage, or external state.
